_readme: The sponsorship tiers and the perks table on /sponsors both live in this file.
TIERS: "id" is what src/data/sponsors.json points at with its "tier" field, and
what each perk's "tiers" list references below. "order" is ascending (1 = entry
tier) and drives both the table columns and the tier sections' order. "size" sets
the sponsor tile size for that tier (lg, md, or sm).
PERKS: one entry per row of the perks table, top to bottom by "order". "tiers" is
the list of tier ids that include this perk. "asterisk" adds a footnote marker,
explained by the body of src/content/pages/sponsorship.mdx.

perks.title: Company Name and Logo on Team Website
Thank You Video from the Team
Company Logo on Team/Pit Banner at Competitions
Invited to competitions as VIP guest (pit tours, meeting the judge, competition overview)
